properties.name: local.proxy.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register this application with a local Caddy proxy on startup.

properties.name: local.proxy.tld
properties.description: TLD used when local.proxy.host is not set.

properties.name: local.proxy.timeout
properties.description: Timeout for calls to the Caddy admin API.

properties.name: local.proxy.schemes
properties.description: Which Caddy listeners to register with: https, http, or both.

properties.name: local.proxy.caddy.servers
properties.description: Server keys in Caddy's config per scheme. Auto-discovered when unset.

properties.name: local.proxy.caddy.ports
properties.description: Ports Caddy listens on per scheme. Read from Caddy's http_port/https_port when unset, falling back to 8080/8443.
